recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel graphic composition featuring four vertical color blocks in magenta, cyan, red, and blue against a yellow background. Each block contains black-ink line drawings of stylized, slightly macabre or eccentric characters in a 1960s comic style, paired with heavy slab-serif and typewriter-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical color columns against a solid yellow field
Black line art characters interacting with their specific color zones
Bold red slab-serif text contrasting with primary color blocks
A diagonal white 'sticker' element breaking the vertical grid
coreInvariants: Uniform black line weight for all illustrations
High-contrast primary and secondary color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four vertical panels of varying heights arranged across the horizontal plane, containing life-sized character illustrations relative to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan panel in the center-left featuring a character in a straitjacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from the top-left title, moving across the 'in action' text, and down through the vertical character panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample yellow space at the bottom and between panels to prevent visual clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow background providing a warm, high-energy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan, Magenta, Red, and Blue blocks defining the character zones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black ink for all outlines and secondary text details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with uniform value, creating a vibrant pop-art effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 6 distinct colors including black and white

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky serifs for the main title
Uniform stroke weight for the typewriter sub-text
Slightly irregular baseline for a hand-stamped feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' in 'action' features a rounded, friendly bowl contrasting the sharp serifs

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over background and color blocks
contained within a white rectangular box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy display slab-serif with a mechanical typewriter face.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and vintage feel.
Captures the mechanical, ink-stamped look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a yellow background with four vertical color blocks (magenta, cyan, red, blue) of varying heights. Include black line art illustrations of eccentric characters in a 1960s comic style within or overlapping these blocks. Leave the top left and a diagonal space on the left magenta block empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy red slab-serif font at the top. Add a white diagonal rectangle on the left with black typewriter-style text inside.

verificationChecks: Are the color blocks flat and vibrant?
Is the line art black and consistent in weight?
Is the main title red and slab-serif?
Is there a diagonal white box with typewriter text?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the white call-out box
mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid copyright
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical
Check that the vertical grid is maintained
Verify the colors do not bleed into each other
Confirm the line art style is consistent across all panels
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vertical Color Blocks] + [1960s Comic Line Art] + [Heavy Red Slab-Serif Title] + [Diagonal Typewriter Call-out] on a [Solid Yellow Background].
